newsitem.title: USA: CompuServe claims leadership in Europe.
newsitem.headline: CompuServe claims leadership in Europe.

text.p: Computer on-line service provider CompuServe Corp said Friday it was the market leader in Europe with plans to grow further.
"CompuServe is the European market-leader among global online service and Internet companies today," it said. "Our strategy calls for continuing this impressive growth."
The provider said it had nearly doubled to 900,000 its membership in Europe during the past 12 months.
"We now have a two-fold lead over the next-largest global competitor in Europe," it said.
On Thursday, the company said its main priority would be to stabilize its earnings and return to profitability as it kept cutting costs and realigning its business structure.
It reported a third-quarter loss of $14.2 million or $0.15 a share against a profit of $0.13 a year ago.
